title: fix(components): the row's leading cell is the selection's hit area (objectui#13016)
body:
Fixes objectui#13016

## What

On list views with tall rows, the row-select checkbox (16px) is hard to hit, and a click beside it bubbled to `onRowClick` and opened the record detail.

- The leading cell (`data-slot="row-leading-cell"`) now toggles the row's selection on any click that is not on the checkbox itself, and shows `cursor-pointer`.
- The row's click filter skips clicks inside the leading cell, so it never navigates.
- Clicks on data cells still open the record.

## Tests

New `data-table-leadingCellHitArea-13016.test.tsx`, run with and without row numbers: a click beside the checkbox selects/deselects without opening; a click on the checkbox toggles once; a data-cell click still opens. The near-miss case fails without the fix (2 failures) and passes with it. All 26 `data-table*` test files pass (189 tests).

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
